tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List the tools of this server with prices, data sources, licensing, daily limits and data freshness.

tools.name: realestate_prices_by_municipality
tools.description: What real estate transaction and contract prices has MLIT (Japan) published for this municipality and quarter? Give a 5-digit municipality code and up to 8 quarters (YYYY-Qn). Per quarter and per classification (never pooled): records_published, no_records_published or unknown with a reason, record

tools.name: realestate_municipalities
tools.description: Which municipality codes and names does MLIT's Real Estate Information Library list for this Japanese prefecture? Give a prefecture code (01-47) or name. Returns the 5-digit municipality codes with Japanese and English names as published by MLIT (XIT002): the join key for realestate_prices_by_munici

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.
